why: ¶157 says the Colonel and the Inspector were awaiting Holmes and Watson in the parlour of the trainer's house, so the name is already used in the story.

text: Thursday evening: back at the villa, in the parlour
why: Holmes said it was Thursday morning (¶13), the travel to Tavistock was in the evening (¶47), and ¶157 places them back at the trainer's house, a villa (¶19, ¶69), in the parlour.
